title: Vampire Vape Tropical Pineapple Dream Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Pineapple Dream Flavour Concentrate from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection captures a creamy-tropical duo of Pawpaw and Pineapple for DIY e-liquid mixing. Pawpaw delivers a smooth custard-like base with flavour notes of Banana, Mango and Melon, while Pineapple brings contrast with a touch of sweetness and gentle acidity. The result is a blend that’s mellow, creamy and easy to layer into a wide range of DIY recipes. This 30ml concentrate must be diluted before use and is intended for experienced DIY e-liquid makers who want to customise their own VG/PG ratios and nicotine strength. Vampire Vape concentrates are made in the UK to exacting standards and offer consistent, reliable flavour. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Shortfill formats.
